hazards.evidence: Large loose area rug/mat lying on the wood floor in the main walking path; edges can catch walker tips.
Coiled hose/cable with loops on the rug and a length trailing across the wood floor walkway toward the right wall — direct trip/catch hazard for a walker.
Shoes, a rolled towel/blanket, and a stack of folded clothes sitting on the floor near the right wall/doorway approach.
Intense sunlight through the large window creates glare and hard bright/dark shadow patches across the floor, which can hide the cord and rug edges from someone using a walker.
